newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Jan-June tax receipts slightly off target.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Jan-June tax receipts slightly off target.

text.p: Portugal's 1997 first half tax receipts rose 8.8 percent over the first six months of 1997, slightly below the budgeted 8.9 percent rise, the Finance Ministry said in a statement.

One reason was the fall in interest rates had led to a drop in income from withholding tax on bank deposits, the ministry said. The cost of some fiscal adjustments had also been slightly underestimated in the budget, it added.
